advances: A strict common missed-region reserve for actual three-body midpoint containment with several nonempty strict residual regions.
author: PK-research-agent
proof:
By the parallel-section lemma, every nonempty $r$-section of $T$ parallel to $P$ has volume strictly less than $|P|_r$. Use orthogonal projection onto $F^\perp$, where $F$ is parallel to $\operatorname{aff}P$. Write $B_y$ for the corresponding affine section of $B$ over $y$, and $y_P$ for the fixed projection of $P$. Then $(P+B)_{y+y_P}=P+B_y$ as actual affine sections. For each section with $|B_y|_r>0$, the $r$-dimensional Brunn–Minkowski inequality in parallel coordinates gives
$$
|P+B_y|_r^{1/r}\ge|P|_r^{1/r}+|B_y|_r^{1/r}>2|B_y|_r^{1/r}.
$$
Orthogonal Fubini gives the strict factor $2^r$ for the full $d$-volumes, since the positive-volume sections integrate to $b>0$. When $r=d$, apply the same comparison directly in the one whole section. [Brunn–Minkowski inequality for convex bodies, equation (3)](https://sites.stat.washington.edu/jaw/COURSES/520s/523/HO.523.20/Gardner.BullAMS.02.pdf).

For $i\notin J$, every selected point has $v_i\cdot P_j<-1$, so the entire hull $P$ lies strictly below $-1$, and $B$ lies at or below $1$. The single actual set $(P+B)/2$ therefore lies in the displayed strict common missed region of $K$. Its volume is $2^{-d}|P+B|$, giving the claimed factor. When $k=m$, the section comparison directly gives $|P|>|T|$, and $P\subseteq A$, $B\subseteq T$ complete the proof.
statement:
Let $d\ge2$, $m=d+1$, and let $v_0,\ldots,v_d$ span $\mathbb R^d$ with sole dependence generated by $\sum_i v_i=0$. Put $T=\{x:v_i\cdot x\le1\ \forall i\}$. Let $A\subset\mathbb R^d$ be a convex body and let $J$ consist of $k$ distinct indices, $2\le k\le m$, for which $R_j=A\cap\bigcap_{i\ne j}\{v_i\cdot x<-1\}$ has positive $d$-volume. Choose any $P_j\in R_j$, put $P=\operatorname{conv}\{P_j:j\in J\}$, and set $r=k-1$. Let $B,K$ be convex bodies with $B\subseteq T$ and $(A+B)/2\subseteq K$, and write $b=|B|$ for $d$-volume. Then
$$
|P+B|>2^r b,\qquad
\left|K\cap\bigcap_{i\notin J}\{v_i\cdot x<0\}\right|
>\frac{b}{2^{d-k+1}}.
$$
For $k=m$ the intersection on the left is $K$, and also $|A|>|T|\ge b$.
title: One residual simplex gives strict Minkowski volume growth
